fields.why: Every VE estimate is vaccinated (by product, dose, time since dose) vs Unvaccinated (Ref), and the Summary's headline is complete-series protection vs unvaccinated; the waning claim contrasts two intervals. Pair leads.

The text reports vaccination proportions per age group ('18%, 17%, and 26% of those aged 3, 4, and 5 years ... had received ≥1 COVID-19 vaccine dose'), an outcome per SPD group across 3 groups set side by side. Table 1 age shares alone would be composition and not qualify.
The per-group outcome is across age (3, 4, 5 years), ordered.
The three age-group coverage values are only shown, with no test across them.
The article is silent on clustering; tests are the unit (multiple tests per child and clustering within 8,741 sites are possible), so silent gives null, not none.

brief_issues: Only label B's full record was in the packet; A rated from its values alone.
